researchMethod: Names, teams and positional rank order are transcribed from the FantasyPros 2026 positional cheat sheet dated 07/30/2026 (top 24 per position); abbreviated names were expanded to full names so they match Sleeper's player dictionary. ADP and ppr_projected_points are DERIVED, not sourced — a positional cheat sheet carries neither column. Projections come from a documented per-position curve over positional rank, the board is ordered by value over replacement (QB12/RB24/WR24/TE12 baselines) with defenses and kickers placed behind all skill players, and ADP is the resulting board position. See scripts/build-rankings.mjs for the model. Because the curves are fitted to reproduce draft order, the point totals are calibrated relative to one another and are not season forecasts. Replace both fields with real values via scripts/import-rankings.mjs as soon as an export with ADP and projection columns is available.
scoring: Full PPR, 12-team, 1 QB / 2 RB / 2 WR / 1 FLEX (RB/WR/TE) / 1 DEF / 1 K
